욥기 19:2.content: How long will ye vex my soul, and break me in pieces with words?

욥기 19:3.content: These ten times have ye reproached me: ye are not ashamed that ye make yourselves strange to me.

욥기 19:4.content: And be it indeed that I have erred, mine error remaineth with myself.

욥기 19:5.content: If indeed ye will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach:

욥기 19:6.content: Know now that God hath overthrown me, and hath compassed me with his net.

욥기 19:7.content: Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard: I cry aloud, but there is no judgment.

욥기 19:8.content: He hath fenced up my way that I cannot pass, and he hath set darkness in my paths.

욥기 19:9.content: He hath stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.

욥기 19:10.content: He hath destroyed me on every side, and I am gone: and mine hope hath he removed like a tree.

욥기 19:11.content: He hath also kindled his wrath against me, and he counteth me unto him as one of his enemies.

욥기 19:12.content: His troops come together, and raise up their way against me, and encamp round about my tabernacle.

욥기 19:13.content: He hath put my brethren far from me, and mine acquaintance are verily estranged from me.

욥기 19:14.content: My kinsfolk have failed, and my familiar friends have forgotten me.

욥기 19:15.content: They that dwell in mine house, and my maids, count me for a stranger: I am an alien in their sight.

욥기 19:16.content: I called my servant, and he gave me no answer; I intreated him with my mouth.

욥기 19:17.content: My breath is strange to my wife, though I intreated for the children’s sake of mine own body.

욥기 19:18.content: Yea, young children despised me; I arose, and they spake against me.

욥기 19:19.content: All my inward friends abhorred me: and they whom I loved are turned against me.

욥기 19:20.content: My bone cleaveth to my skin and to my flesh, and I am escaped with the skin of my teeth.

욥기 19:21.content: Have pity upon me, have pity upon me, O ye my friends; for the hand of God hath touched me.

욥기 19:22.content: Why do ye persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?

욥기 19:23.content: Oh that my words were now written! oh that they were printed in a book!

욥기 19:24.content: That they were graven with an iron pen and lead in the rock for ever!

욥기 19:25.content: For I know that my redeemer liveth, and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth:

욥기 19:26.content: And though after my skin worms destroy this body, yet in my flesh shall I see God:

욥기 19:27.content: Whom I shall see for myself, and mine eyes shall behold, and not another; though my reins be consumed within me.

욥기 19:28.content: But ye should say, Why persecute we him, seeing the root of the matter is found in me?

욥기 19:29.content: Be ye afraid of the sword: for wrath bringeth the punishments of the sword, that ye may know there is a judgment.
